apps.title: Apps
apps.description: App Store URLs (https://apps.apple.com/us/app/.../id284882215), numeric app ids, or app names (the first search match is used).

countries.title: Countries (storefronts)
countries.description: Two-letter country codes such as us, gb, de, ua. Use "top" for 18 large markets or "all" for ~100 storefronts. Apple serves up to 500 latest reviews per storefront, so more countries = more reviews.

sortBy.title: Sort
sortBy.description: Most recent (best for monitoring) or most helpful reviews.

sinceDate.title: Only reviews since (date)
sinceDate.description: Optional. YYYY-MM-DD. Use with a daily or weekly schedule to get only new reviews and pay only for those.

minRating.title: Minimum stars
minRating.description: Keep only reviews with at least this many stars.

maxRating.title: Maximum stars
maxRating.description: Set to 2 to collect only negative reviews (bug reports, churn reasons).

keywords.title: Keywords filter
keywords.description: Optional. Keep only reviews whose title or text contains any of these words (case-insensitive), e.g. crash, refund, subscription.
